name: ASMC / Shanghai Advanced Semiconductor Manufacturing
reason_en: Not counted as an additional current vendor: the joint issuer announcement confirms the GTA merger became effective on 2019-01-25. Current GTA processes are included.
reason_zh: 不另计为一家现行厂商：双方公告确认与积塔的合并于2019-01-25生效。本轮已收录现行积塔平台。

name: Bosch — other sites and process generations
reason_en: Reutlingen is included. Other site plans are not treated as completed production without site-specific evidence.
reason_zh: 已收录罗伊特林根；其他厂区规划在缺少该厂区具体证据时不视为已完成量产。

name: CSMC / China Resources Shanghua / 华润上华
reason_en: Not counted separately from CRMicro. A 2013 official release establishes the Shanghua foundry relationship; 2025 report platforms are attributed to the group, not automatically to one subsidiary.
reason_zh: 不与华润微重复计数。2013年官方稿确认上华代工业务归属；2025年报平台归于集团，不自动认定由某一家子公司制造。

name: Episil — BCD process details
reason_en: The official 2023 ESG report, printed p.105, describes a plan to develop 0.5 µm 700 V BCD. Current completion, operating limits and PDK access remain unverified; it is not added as a current production platform.
reason_zh: 官方2023年ESG报告印刷第105页披露计划开发0.5微米700V BCD；当前完成情况、工作限制及PDK准入仍未核实，不作为现行量产平台加入。

name: ESWIN Materials / 奕斯伟材料
reason_en: Official body describes polished and epitaxial silicon-wafer materials. No analog-IC wafer-foundry platform was verified; substrate manufacturing is outside this catalogue.
reason_zh: 官方正文描述抛光片、外延片等硅片材料；未核实模拟芯片晶圆代工平台。衬底制造不纳入本目录。

name: Fuji Electric Matsumoto 200 mm SiC
reason_en: The 2025 report describes construction of an 8-inch pilot line. No separate 200 mm mass-production row is added; the explicitly operating 150 mm Tsugaru line is recorded.
reason_zh: 2025年报告描述建设8英寸中试线，未另增200毫米量产条目；记录明确已运行的150毫米津轻产线。

name: GlobalFoundries — HVS SiGe quantitative limits
reason_en: HVS is named, but its numeric voltage and node mapping are not disclosed in the reviewed page; no guessed rating was added.
reason_zh: 页面列出HVS，但未公开数值电压与节点对应关系，未添加猜测等级。

name: HLMC / 上海华力
reason_en: Official homepage returned no readable body. No separately verified process row added; press summaries alone were not promoted to platform evidence.
reason_zh: 官方网站未返回可读正文；本轮不新增独立工艺记录，不把媒体概述提升为平台依据。

name: HuaLei / 华磊
reason_en: No verified analog/power process offering was established for this name. It is not treated as HLMC or as a GaN power foundry.
reason_zh: 该名称尚未落实为可核实的模拟／电源工艺服务；未将其等同于华力或GaN功率代工厂。

name: IGSS GaN
reason_en: The official page describes GaN-on-Si services and 200 mm CMOS-compatible fabrication, but this review did not establish the fabrication site's legal operator/location. Generic market voltage examples are not qualified platform ratings. Pending manufacturing-entity verification.
reason_zh: 官网描述GaN-on-Si服务及200毫米CMOS兼容制造，但本轮未确立制造场址的法律运营主体及地点。泛指市场的电压示例不是认证平台额定值。等待制造主体核验。

name: IHP — additional SiGe / photonic processes
reason_en: SG13G2 is included. Additional research processes require their own platform and maturity checks before inheriting performance or MPW claims.
reason_zh: 已收录SG13G2；其他研究工艺须单独核对平台及成熟度，不能继承性能或MPW结论。

name: JS Foundry
reason_en: Investor Mercuria reports a bankruptcy filing and cessation of operations. Excluded from the current operating-foundry list; historical technology is not treated as currently available.
reason_zh: 投资方Mercuria公告破产申请及停止经营。排除于当前运行代工厂清单；历史技术不视为当前可用。

name: LFoundry — 120 / 150 / 200 V BS-LDMOS
reason_en: Explicitly marked under development; not added as released voltage options.
reason_zh: 明确标为开发中，未当作已发布电压选项新增。

name: Microsemi standalone foundry
reason_en: Microchip custom services are included. No separate currently marketed Microsemi foundry platform with a public node/voltage table was verified; no duplicate manufacturer added.
reason_zh: 已收录微芯定制服务；未核实具有公开节点/电压表且当前独立推广的Microsemi代工平台，未重复计算制造主体。

name: Nexperia — Hamburg WBG expansion
reason_en: The 2024 announcement mixes started initial lines with future 200 mm SiC MOSFET / GaN HEMT milestones. Completion of every future milestone was not independently established.
reason_zh: 2024年公告同时含已启动初始产线和未来200毫米SiC MOSFET/GaN HEMT节点，未独立确立所有未来节点均已完成。

name: NXP — newer internal smart-power families
reason_en: SMARTMOS 8MV is retained as historical evidence. This does not establish current external foundry access or qualify subsequent SMARTMOS generations.
reason_zh: SMARTMOS 8MV仅保留为历史依据，不能证明当前对外代工开放或后续SMARTMOS代际认证。

name: Polar — additional discrete / bipolar offerings
reason_en: Other listed families await separate maturity and access checks.
reason_zh: 其他已列示家族尚待分别核对成熟度及开放条件。

name: Polar — imec GaN transfer
reason_en: Partnership describes a manufacturing path. The imec 24–1200 V technology base does not establish that every voltage is transferred and qualified at Polar.
reason_zh: 合作页面描述制造路径；imec的24～1200V技术基础不能证明每个电压选项均已在Polar完成转移和认证。

name: Qorvo
reason_en: Candidate for a later RF/compound expansion; no platform record verified in this pass.
reason_zh: 后续射频／化合物扩展候选；本轮未核实可收录的平台条目。

name: Seiko Epson CTC BiC-DMOS
reason_en: CTC is explicitly marked under development in the official COT table. It is not added as a current qualified offering; CRC is recorded separately. The transfer-service voltage examples are not CRC or CTC qualifications.
reason_zh: 官方COT表明确将CTC标为开发中，未作为当前已认证工艺单独加入；CRC另行记录。工艺转移服务的电压示例不构成CRC或CTC认证。

name: Silan — new 12-inch analog fab
reason_en: 2026-01-05 official release describes construction start and a planned initial line opening in 2027 Q4; no published process node/voltage or current production platform was established.
reason_zh: 2026-01-05官方稿披露开工，计划2027年第四季度初步通线；未形成已公开节点/电压及当前量产平台证据。

name: SilTerra high-voltage Power MOS page
reason_en: The page body read during research showed Under Construction. No numeric high-voltage Power MOS platform is added from it; the separately evidenced D18V BCD row is retained.
reason_zh: 研究时读取的该页正文为建设中。未据此增加带数值的高压Power MOS平台；保留另有依据的D18V BCD条目。

name: Skyworks Solutions
reason_en: Candidate for a later RF/compound expansion; no platform record verified in this pass.
reason_zh: 后续射频／化合物扩展候选；本轮未核实可收录的平台条目。

name: Sumitomo Electric Device Innovations
reason_en: Candidate for a later RF/compound expansion; no platform record verified in this pass.
reason_zh: 后续射频／化合物扩展候选；本轮未核实可收录的平台条目。

name: Teledyne DALSA — historical HV-CMOS
reason_en: The current source verifies MEMS services. Current access, node and voltage for historical HV-CMOS platforms were not established in this pass.
reason_zh: 当前来源证实MEMS服务；本轮未确立历史高压CMOS平台当前开放状态、节点及电压。

name: Vishay — Newport SiC platform
reason_en: Issuer reporting describes scaling and further development. A released commercial foundry platform with public process rules was not established.
reason_zh: 发行人资料描述扩产及进一步开发；未确立已发布且公开工艺规则的商业代工平台。

name: Wavetek Microelectronics
reason_en: Candidate for a later RF/compound expansion; no platform record verified in this pass.
reason_zh: 后续射频／化合物扩展候选；本轮未核实可收录的平台条目。

name: X-FAB — further bulk CMOS / sensor modules
reason_en: RF-SOI, XDH10 and XDM10 supplement existing XT011/XT018. Additional sensor and bulk-CMOS modules remain outside this bounded expansion.
reason_zh: 本轮以RF-SOI、XDH10、XDM10补充已有XT011/XT018；其他传感及体硅CMOS模块尚未纳入本次有限扩充。
